rules.statement: A party claiming the benefit of Section 83 of the Trust Ordinance must establish that they did not intend to dispose of the beneficial interest in the property transferred.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the owner of property transfers or bequeaths it, and it cannot reasonably be inferred consistently with the attendant circumstances that he intended to dispose of the beneficial interest therein, the transferee or legatee must hold such property for the benefit of the owner or his legal representative
